name: transport_unknown_field
description: BONUS fixture (not one of the six required G1 scenarios, included for thoroughness): the JSON body itself is well-formed but carries an undocumented top-level field. The mock's decoder uses DisallowUnknownFields, so this is rejected at the transport layer (HTTP 400) before it ever becomes a decision.Request -- there is no decision.Result for this case at all. Demonstrates the *other* place 'malformed input' can be rejected, distinct from fixture 06's decision-core-level malformed_request.
